name: Send Message to Personal AI
description: Send a message to a Personal AI persona and get an AI-generated response. Supports session continuity, context injection, document references, and memory stacking.

text.description: Message to send to the AI

domainName.description: The hyphenated domain name of the AI persona (found under the AI's name in Persona view)

context.description: Additional context for the AI response (e.g., 'Reply in one sentence')

sessionId.description: Session ID to continue an existing conversation

userName.description: Name of the user sending the message

isStack.description: Set true to also add the message to the AI's memory
